mapper.sql: id, application_no, applicant_id, applicant_name, department_id, mobile_ciphertext, id_card_ciphertext, account_ciphertext, counterparty_account_ciphertext, amount, currency, purpose, risk_score, risk_level, status, current_level, rejection_reason, version, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO transaction_application (application_no, applicant_id, applicant_name, department_id, mobile_ciphertext, id_card_ciphertext, account_ciphertext, counterparty_account_ciphertext, amount, currency, purpose, risk_score, risk_level, status, current_level, rejection_reason, version, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{applicationNo}, #{applicantId}, #{applicantName}, #{departmentId}, #{mobileCiphertext}, #{idCardCiphertext}, #{accountCiphertext}, #{counterpartyAccountCiphertext}, #{amount}, #{currency}, #{purpose}, #{riskScore}, #{riskLevel}, #{status}, #{currentLevel}, #{rejectionReason}, #{version}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})

where.if: AND (application_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR purpose LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.update: UPDATE transaction_application SET status = #{nextStatus}, current_level = #{nextLevel}, rejection_reason = #{rejectionReason}, risk_score = #{riskScore}, risk_level = #{riskLevel}, version = version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{expectedVersion} AND status = #{expectedStatus}

UPDATE transaction_application SET mobile_ciphertext = #{tx.mobileCiphertext}, id_card_ciphertext = #{tx.idCardCiphertext}, account_ciphertext = #{tx.accountCiphertext}, counterparty_account_ciphertext = #{tx.counterpartyAccountCiphertext}, amount = #{tx.amount}, currency = #{tx.currency}, purpose = #{tx.purpose}, risk_score = #{tx.riskScore}, risk_level = #{tx.riskLevel}, status = #{tx.status}, current_level = #{tx.currentLevel}, rejection_reason = NULL, version = version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{tx.id} AND version = #{expectedVersion} AND status = #{expectedStatus}
